name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted appointment scheduler with a public booking page, provider calendars, working plans and email notifications, backed by MySQL.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: the setup wizard is public until it is completed, and it creates the admin account.
Email notifications need SMTP: set MAIL_PROTOCOL to smtp and fill in the MAIL_SMTP_* and MAIL_FROM_* variables, then redeploy.
